name: MRPeasy
description_en:
MRPeasy is a hosted manufacturing planning and ERP system aimed at smaller manufacturers. Its workflow connects customer demand, bills of materials, capacity, purchasing, shop-floor reporting and inventory/financial information.

The selected plan matters for quality, serials, multiple sites, barcodes and API access. This profile follows current production and pricing documentation, not a factory implementation or measured scheduling result. No trial, manufacturing order or integration was executed.
description_zh:
MRPeasy 是面向较小制造企业的托管生产规划及 ERP，连接客户需求、物料清单、产能、采购、现场报工及库存财务资料。

质检、序列号、多地点、条码和 API 等能力取决于所选套餐。本文依据当前生产和定价资料，不是工厂实施或排程实测；未执行试用、制造单或集成。

core_features.explanation_en: Plan manufacturing against incoming demand, available materials and production capacity, then reschedule using calendars/Gantt views.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按需求、齐料及产能规划生产，并用日历甘特视图重排。

core_features.explanation_en: Workers report activity and material use through dedicated interfaces or mobile apps described by the vendor.
core_features.explanation_zh: 厂商介绍通过专用界面或移动应用报告工作及耗料。

core_features.explanation_en: The pricing matrix separates lot tracing from higher-plan quality, serial, barcode and multi-site capabilities.
core_features.explanation_zh: 定价表区分批次追溯与较高套餐的质检、序列号、条码及多地点能力。

pricing.billing_basis: Plan/user rate for first ten, then $79 monthly blocks of ten; annual option, Unlimited minimum and optional support differ.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Displayed monthly rates $49/$69/$99/$149 per user; from user 11 add $79 per ten-user block. Fifteen-plus-fifteen-day trial advertised.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 展示每用户月费 $49/$69/$99/$149；第十一用户起每组十用户另 $79。宣传 15+15 天试用。

sources.title: Production Planning Software for Manufacturing
sources.research_notes_en: Demand/material/capacity planning, shop reporting and procurement path; no scheduling benchmark.

sources.title: MRPeasy Pricing | Manufacturing Software Plans | Free Trial
sources.research_notes_en: Detailed plan capabilities, displayed rates, ten-user bundles, minimums, trial and support distinctions.

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_zh: 追踪按需求形成的制造工作
sections.en:
The planning page describes estimating production cost/lead time, scheduling against material and capacity, reserving stock and generating purchase orders for shortages. Workers then report progress and material use. A proposed test is one assembly requiring two components when one is short: inspect procurement, schedule, actual consumption and finished stock together.

Change the priority or record a longer operation to see what updates. These are evaluation suggestions, not verified scheduling outcomes. A planned completion date is only as useful as the BOM, routing, calendar and recorded shop activity behind it.
sections.zh:
规划页介绍估计成本交期、按物料产能排程、预留库存及为缺料生成采购单，再由工人报告进度耗料。可测试一个需要两种组件而其中一种缺货的组装，联合检查采购、排程、实际耗料及成品。

再调整优先级或记录工序超时，观察更新。这些属于评估建议，不是已验证排程效果；完工日期依赖背后的 BOM、路线、日历和现场记录。

sections.title_en: Match the retained plan to production exceptions
sections.title_zh: 按生产异常选择最终保留套餐
sections.en:
The current cards put production/BOM planning and lot traceability in Starter. Professional adds capabilities including serial numbers, expiry, subcontracting and quality control. Enterprise adds multiple stocks/sites, barcode, backward scheduling, RMA and revisions. Unlimited lists API/webhooks for paid accounts and has a two-user minimum.

Confirm the precise retained entitlement rather than testing only in the full-feature trial. For example, lot identity does not automatically establish serial-level or expiry behavior. Check a quality hold, subcontract issue/return and an RMA only on a plan that actually includes those functions. No API, accounting connector or production exception was tested.
sections.zh:
当前卡片将生产物料规划及批次追溯列入 Starter；Professional 增加序列号、有效期、外协及质量控制等；Enterprise 增加多库存地点、条码、倒排、RMA 和版本；Unlimited 列出付费账户 API/webhooks，且至少两用户。

应确认最终保留权限，不只在全功能试用中测试。批次身份不自动等于序列号或有效期功能；质检冻结、外协收发及退货授权需在包含它们的套餐检查。本次未测试 API、会计连接器或生产异常。

sections.title_en: User bundles change the cost curve after ten users
sections.title_zh: 十用户之后按用户包改变费用曲线
sections.en:
The pricing page read on 22 October 2026 displays monthly per-user rates of $49 Starter, $69 Professional, $99 Enterprise and $149 Unlimited, with annual billing offering one month free. The displayed dollar sign alone was not used to assign an ISO currency. After the first ten users, each additional block of ten costs $79 monthly.

Its own example gives twelve Enterprise users as $990 + $79 = $1,069 monthly, not twelve times $99. Optional training/advanced support are separate, while mandatory implementation/training purchase is not required according to the FAQ. Verify billing mode, active users, optional assistance and any external-service fees before comparing totals.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的定价页展示每用户月价 Starter $49、Professional $69、Enterprise $99、Unlimited $149，年付优惠一个月。本次不只凭 $ 符号设定 ISO 币种。前十用户之后，每增加一组十用户每月 $79。

页面自己的十二个 Enterprise 用户算例是 $990 + $79 = 每月 $1,069，并非十二乘 $99。可选培训和高级支持另计；FAQ 说明没有强制购买实施培训。比较总额前需核对付款模式、活跃用户、可选帮助及外部服务费。

sections.title_en: Separate the trial, assistance and operational ownership
sections.title_zh: 区分试用、帮助与运营责任
sections.en:
The site advertises a 15+15-day trial without a credit card. It is not a permanent free production plan. Public learning material and a chatbot are free; paid-account ticket support, optional training and external implementation consultants are different forms of help. The page explicitly notes the chatbot can make mistakes.

Before migration, reconcile items/units, BOMs/routes, warehouses, open work and stock/WIP balances. Request representative export and recovery evidence, and define who corrects missed or duplicate reporting. The fit is strongest to investigate where someone owns that manufacturing data; an invoice-only team may not need it. Trial extension terms, hosting contracts, regional filings, security and restore reliability remain unverified.
sections.zh:
网站宣传无需信用卡的 15+15 天试用，不是永久免费生产方案。公开学习资料和聊天助手免费；付费账户工单支持、可选培训及外部实施顾问是不同帮助形式。页面明确提示聊天助手可能犯错。

迁移前应对清物品单位、物料路线、仓库、未结工作及库存在制余额，并取得代表性导出恢复证据，明确谁处理漏报或重复报工。有专人负责制造数据时值得调查，只有开票需求可能用不到。试用延期细则、托管合同、地区申报、安全和恢复可靠性仍未核实。

research_gaps.en: Trial extension, ISO currency, exact API entitlement and regional contract/filing coverage require confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 试用延期、ISO 币种、确切 API 权限及地区合同申报覆盖需确认。

research_gaps.en: No manufacturing order, schedule, quality/return, integration, migration, security or restore was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试制造单、排程、质检退货、集成、迁移、安全或恢复。
